Preserves the donor row-cooperative unmasked and masked loss/gradient kernels, explicit FP32 sum-and-mean lowering, mask-zero behavior, selected-row normalization, and logits-only adjoint while adapting attributes, storage-helper names, and the currently admitted U32/Int32 target ABI.

Preserves the donor FP32 Adam moment, bias-correction, and parameter-update order while adapting attributes, storage helpers, and bindless ABI spelling.

Preserves the donor hoisted whole-sequence input projection, one-workgroup-per-batch recurrent scan, explicit caller-owned cell state, zero initial state, optional recurrent bias, saved recurrent state, and one-dispatch BPTT. Input projection and parameter adjoints reuse canonical Linear operations instead of retaining the temporary monolithic Rust kernels.

Preserves the donor rank-three NN, NT, and TN layouts, FP32 accumulation, 16x16 shared-memory candidates, exact >=8 route threshold, and reverse formulas composed from the same three semantic operations. OARS allocates unused local IDs because committed compatibility identities occupy donor-local IDs 293-295.
Preserves the donor contiguous BS,D to BH,S,D/H permutation, its exact inverse, and inverse-operation adjoints. The one-head path remains a zero-copy differentiable reshape view.
Preserves the donor fused scale-plus-additive-mask final-axis softmax, the <=32-column narrow schedule, detached mask semantics, and saved-output adjoint.

Preserves the donor standard provider as BMM-NT, implicit-causal or optional-additive-mask Softmax, and BMM, plus the causal Flash provider with FP32 log-sum-exp saved state and its deterministic two-dispatch adjoint. Both providers retain one SDPA semantic identity.

Preserves the donor selected-expert probability normalization, invalid-index behavior, detached routing decisions, and exact dense probability adjoint while adapting names, attributes, storage helpers, and the bindless ABI spelling.

Preserves the donor FP32 last-axis RMS, input adjoint, per-row weight contribution, epsilon, reduction order, and bindless buffer order while adapting names and OA attributes.

Preserves the donor Llama-style split-half rotary pairing, theta base, position offset, forward rotation, transpose adjoint, and one-thread-per-pair dispatch while adapting names, attributes, and bindless ABI spelling.

Preserves the donor FP32 activation formulas, saved-input/output adjoint choices, scalar alpha parameters, and elementwise dispatch while adapting names, attributes, and bindless ABI spelling.

Preserves the donor NCHW FP32 max selection, first-maximum tie rule, explicit argmax result, deterministic gather-style adjoint, and parameterless module contract while correcting the donor shader's float-encoded UInt32 index mismatch and adapting Rust naming, checked arithmetic, attributes, and bindless ABI spelling.

The donor-generated header accepts one square extent while its tests call two extents, and its implementation derives both spatial axes from height before invoking a square fixed-window pool. OARS implements the intended independent adaptive-bin geometry for rectangular and non-divisible inputs while retaining NCHW ownership and deterministic adjoints.

Preserves NCHW per-channel normalization, affine parameters, momentum running state, and train/eval behavior while replacing the donor's cancellation-prone E[x^2]-E[x]^2 variance with centered variance and honoring inference mode in the input adjoint.

Preserves the donor integer-scale nearest and align-corners-false half-pixel bilinear NCHW formulas while replacing the bilinear float-atomic adjoint with deterministic gather ownership and adapting Rust naming, validation, attributes, and bindless ABI spelling.

Preserves the donor NCHW grouped-convolution geometry, OIHW-grouped weight layout, bias epilogue, and all three adjoints while replacing unsigned coordinate underflow and the donor parameter-adjoint shader's invalid bias identifiers with deterministic signed-coordinate gather reductions.

Preserves the donor NCL im2col layout, existing 64x64x16 tiled MatMulNt route, in-place last-axis bias broadcast, batched channels-first transpose, dilation geometry, and explicit deterministic data/parameter adjoints while representing the four-node forward and two-node backward as single semantic operations.

Preserves the donor bias-free NCL transposed-convolution geometry and IOK weight layout. Forward is the existing Conv1d data adjoint; backward reuses the canonical Conv1d im2col plus 64x64x16 tiled MatMulNt route and deterministic parameter adjoint as one semantic operation rather than introducing a second convolution implementation.

Preserves the donor NCHW transposed-convolution geometry, IOKK weight layout, channel-bias epilogue, Conv2d data-adjoint forward, regular-Conv2d input adjoint, and deterministic weight/bias adjoints while replacing donor unsigned coordinate underflow with signed checks and retaining one semantic forward and backward operation.

Preserves the donor whole-sequence GRU scan, reset/update/candidate gate order, zero initial state, optional recurrent bias, saved previous-hidden state, and one-dispatch BPTT recurrence. The recurrence-free input projection and recurrent parameter adjoint reuse the canonical Linear operations, so no timestep-level host loop or duplicate GEMM path is introduced.

Preserves the donor NCHW FP32 window geometry, edge-count divisor, one-output/one-input invocation ownership, saved-input adjoint, and parameterless module contract while adapting Rust naming, checked arithmetic, attributes, and bindless ABI spelling.
